text:
SparkBridge Capital is a fast-growing fintech startup turning complex corporate finance into simple, data-driven decisions for mid-market businesses. We're building an analytics-first treasury and planning platform that helps finance teams forecast, optimize cash, and run scenario-driven strategy. Join us to bring clarity to chaos.

What you'll do
- Build and maintain detailed financial models to support forecasting, valuation, and scenario analysis.
- Lead month-end FP&A activities: consolidate inputs, reconcile variances, and produce actionable management reports.
- Drive budgeting and rolling forecast cycles; partner with business stakeholders to translate strategy into numbers.
- Use Microsoft Excel to develop automated templates, dashboards, and KPI trackers for the finance team.
- Support ERP processes and reporting in SAP FICO, ensuring accurate GL postings and reconciliations.
- Prepare presentations for leadership and investors, highlighting drivers, risks, and recommendations.

What we need (mandatory)
- 4-7 years experience working in financial planning, analytics, corporate finance, or related roles.
- Financial Modeling
- FP&A
- Microsoft Excel
- SAP FICO

Bonus points (preferred/good-to-have)
- IFRS
- Variance Analysis

Location and work mode
Fully remote within India.
